    // Decimation under an error bound: every edge whose quadric error is at or
    // below `maxError` is a candidate, and passes run until the budget is spent.
    // The bound is in squared distance units, because a quadric accumulates
    // SQUARED distances.
    DecimatedToError(self: TriangleMesh3D, maxError: Number, passes: Integer): TriangleMesh3D
        => Repeat(passes, 0).Reduce(self, (mesh, pass) => mesh.DecimationErrorPass(maxError));
